name: BlockBatchClearing
summary: Queues every swap in a block and clears them at one uniform price, so ordering inside the block stops being worth anything.

name: TopOfBlockAuction
summary: An on-chain auction for the right to trade first in a block. The winning bid is paid to liquidity providers.

name: FlowClassifier
summary: Publishes a running toxic-versus-benign classification of a pool's order flow on-chain, as a public good other hooks can read.

name: ImpactSplit
summary: Splits a large swap into tranches across blocks and guarantees the result beats immediate execution or refunds the difference.

name: SandwichBond
summary: Lets a swapper post a bond that is returned unless a same-block backrun is detected, in which case it compensates them.

name: YieldSpace
summary: A fixed-rate curve with a maturity, converging to par at expiry. Interest-rate markets as a native v4 pool.

name: LMSR
summary: A logarithmic market scoring rule curve, giving prediction markets bounded loss and always-available liquidity.

name: PowerPerp
summary: An `x^p` invariant, so an LP position has power-perpetual payoff instead of the usual square-root exposure.

name: RatchetFloor
summary: A protocol-owned bid that can only move up, giving a token a floor price that is enforced by the curve.

name: GridLadder
summary: Asymmetric bid and ask ladders in one position, so an LP can quote a spread rather than a symmetric range.

name: DutchClearingLaunch
summary: A descending-price launch that ends in a single clearing price, refunding everyone who bid above it.

name: StepCurve
summary: Piecewise-constant prices, for assets that should trade in discrete steps rather than on a continuum.

name: RebaseAbsorb
summary: Makes rebasing tokens safe in v4 by absorbing balance drift into the pool as a donation to liquidity providers.

name: FeeOnTransfer
summary: Makes fee-on-transfer tokens work by settling on measured balance deltas instead of requested amounts.

name: YieldDiscount
summary: Parks idle reserves in an ERC-4626 vault and pays the yield out as fee discounts to swappers.

name: DividendPassthrough
summary: Routes dividends paid to pool-held tokens through to liquidity providers pro rata.

name: WrappedNativeYield
summary: On chains with native yield, donates the pool's accrued yield to in-range liquidity.

name: OracleBand
summary: Requires a swap to clear within a band around a signed reference price, so a thin pool cannot be walked away from reality.

name: ILInsurance
summary: Skims a slice of fees into a vault that pays impermanent-loss claims to the providers who funded it.

name: DrawdownCap
summary: Caps how much price impact one address may cause per epoch.

name: TickHarberger
summary: Auctions the exclusive right to provide liquidity at the active tick under a Harberger tax, so it is always for sale.

name: TenureWeightedFees
summary: Weights fee share by continuous time in the pool, so capital that stays is paid more than capital that visits.

name: RangeRent
summary: Charges and pays rent for range occupancy based on how much of the range was actually used.

name: AutoCompoundDonate
summary: Donates accrued fees straight back to in-range liquidity, compounding without touching positions.

name: RetroRebate
summary: Pays volume rebates from on-chain epoch accounting, with no Merkle drop and no off-chain claim.

name: FungibleRange
summary: Tokenises a range position as an ERC-20 so it can be traded, lent and used as collateral.

name: X402Gate
summary: Meters pool access with x402 payment receipts, so an autonomous agent can pay per swap for a better fee tier.

name: ERC8004ReputationFee
summary: Sets the fee tier from the swapper's on-chain agent reputation.

name: AgentBudget
summary: Enforces per-agent rate limits and spend budgets in the pool itself, not in the agent's own code.

name: IntentSettle
summary: Settles signed ERC-7683 intents against pool liquidity, with solvers competing on the fill.

name: HookMeter
summary: Instruments another hook: gas, revert rate and fee take, published on-chain for anyone to audit.

name: HookStack
summary: Runs an ordered stack of sub-hooks on one pool, each with its own gas budget.

name: ExpirySettle
summary: Gives a pool a maturity date at which it settles, turning it into a dated instrument.

name: VestedBuy
summary: Vests purchases linearly and enforces the schedule at the pool rather than in a token contract.

name: EpochRebalance
summary: Rebalances the pool toward a target weight each epoch, making the pool itself an index.

name: StreamDCA
summary: Executes recurring dollar-cost-average streams block by block.

name: SharedLiquidity
summary: Mirrors one pool across chains and settles the net position, so liquidity is not fragmented per chain.

name: L1Anchor
summary: Anchors an L2 pool to a proven L1 price.

name: VarianceSwap
summary: Pays realized variance, making liquidity providers short volatility and traders long it, explicitly.

name: ImpliedVolFee
summary: Prices swaps off an implied-volatility surface rather than a realized-volatility estimate.

name: CommitRevealDark
summary: Hides order size behind a hash commitment and clears the batch on reveal.

name: LotteryFees
summary: Sends a slice of fees to a no-loss lottery among the pool's liquidity providers.

name: ReserveStable
summary: Mints and burns against a reserve to hold a band, with the band enforced by the hook.
